verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 at buildwithfern.com/openapi.json with an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. Docs evidence covers Fern consuming customer OpenAPI specs, not publishing its own, so it does not corroborate this. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec's location, scope and versioning; confirmation that it covers Fern's full API surface; independent corroboration.
